ui_mode.title: Interface
ui_mode.desc: How tools are offered: the ribbon, a floating rail, or a minimal dock. Ctrl+K finds every command in each of them.
ui_mode.ribbon.desc: Tabs with labelled buttons, as in other BIM editors.
ui_mode.rail.desc: A slim rail over the drawing. Sections open as panels; Ctrl+\ shows labels.
ui_mode.minimal.desc: A dock of drawing tools, a bar over the selection, and Ctrl+K.
